description: Register `web-search.live` (SCOPE_EXTERNAL — rate-limited, reached only on explicit `--type web`/`--all` or fallback escalation) and `web-search.learnings` (SCOPE_PROJECT — local findings corpus, always safe to query, joins default routing) with self-registration at startup.

requirements.description: At service startup, web-search must self-register two providers with the search-hub federation layer: (1) web-search.live with SCOPE_EXTERNAL, rate-limited, reachable only on explicit --type web / --all flags or fallback escalation; (2) web-search.learnings with SCOPE_PROJECT, safe to query on any default federated route. Registration must use the standard .vrooli/search.json provider descriptor format and the search-hub ResultMapping and control-token contract. Both providers must be registered before the service begins accepting requests.
requirements.title: Dual Search-Hub Provider Self-Registration at Startup

validation.notes: Provider descriptor for web-search.live has scope=SCOPE_EXTERNAL and explicit-only routing flag set to true
Provider descriptor for web-search.learnings has scope=SCOPE_PROJECT and is included in default routing set
Registration function is called during service initialization before the HTTP server begins accepting connections (verified via startup lifecycle order test)
Both provider descriptors conform to the .vrooli/search.json JSON schema (schema validation test)
After service startup, querying the search-hub provider registry returns both web-search.live and web-search.learnings with correct scope metadata
A default federated query issued after startup routes to web-search.learnings and does NOT invoke web-search.live (verified by asserting zero HTTP calls to SearXNG)
The system administrator can inspect the search-hub registry post-startup and confirm both providers are present with correct scope and routing constraints

title: Dual Search-Hub Provider Registration
